text:
alice: Heads-up: PR #4980 failing docs-snippet CI. The embeddings examples show "input": "hello" (string) in the curl/python snippets but the SDK and runtime expect an array `inputs: ["hello"]`. Also the OpenAPI example uses `vector` in the response sample but runtime returns `embedding`.

ben: Repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4980

claire: I can take this. Which files exactly? I saw api-ref/embeddings.yaml and samples/embeds.md plus the py/js snippets in guides/usage.md.

ben: Yep those three. Also curl is missing the Content-Type header in the sample. The node example calls `client.embeddings({input: 'hi'})` but our JS SDK settled on `inputs: ['hi']` last quarter.

alice: And FYI the OpenAPI example uses `model_name` instead of `model` (leftover from older drafts). We normalized to `model` so tests that validate example against schema are failing.

claire: Plan: update api-ref/embeddings.yaml example -> use `model` and `inputs: ["..."]`, change response field `vector` -> `embedding`, add Content-Type header in curl and adjust python/node snippets. I'll add a snippet-linter test to catch stringified arrays/numeric fields.

claire: quick example replacement I will push:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-1","inputs":["hello world"]}'
```
Response example:
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.123, -0.045, ...],"index":0}],"model":"embed-1"}
```

ben: Please add a CHANGELOG line under docs/changes.md referencing test id snip-047 so QA can track it.

claire: Pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ef12c3a. Updated openapi example, snippets, and added linter rule. Ran docs-lint locally, snippet tests now pass.

docs-bot: build-docs #1289 started for branch fix/embeds-examples (triggered by claire)

ben: Nice. Can you also add a short note in api-ref/embeddings.yaml comment about `inputs` vs legacy `input` for future maintainers? Small inline comment is fine.

claire: Done, added YAML comment and a small entry in docs/changes.md. Updated PR description to explain behavioral divergence we saw in earlier SDK versions.

docs-bot: build-docs #1289 succeeded for branch fix/embeds-examples

alice: CI green, thanks @claire and @ben. If anything else pops from snippet CI, ping #docs. Closing thread :white_check_mark:
